products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is an AI software company focused on legal and professional services, offering a platform it describes as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms. The company targets law firms and corporate legal teams and positions its technology as a tool for contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation work. In 2025 the company reported customer wins, product updates, and expanded global presence, and it publishes research findings while contributing to open-source development.

The company's primary product, Harvey AI, functions as a legal AI assistant covering contract drafting, case research, and related tasks. A customer testimonial from Dr. Claudia Junker describes the platform as having transformed how her organization works by enabling more precise navigation of complex legal issues.

The site's held facts note category placement in Finance and Legal AI, and flag concerns around law firm data exposure and legal privilege as relevant considerations associated with the product. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the available data.
